name: Learning-Space Graphs Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: A nonempty coordinate conditioning of a learning-space graph need not be a learning-space graph.
proof: The recorded accessible union-closed family is a learning space, but conditioning on item $1$ yields $K_{1,3}$. No choice of a root makes the three-leaf star's rooted orientation closed, because two outgoing edges at its center would require a missing square.
